steps.description: Gather and preprocess datasets for model training, including data cleaning and feature engineering.
Design and implement AI model architectures using deep learning frameworks.
Configure hyperparameters for model training, including learning rates, batch sizes, and regularization techniques.
Train AI models using selected datasets and hyperparameters, monitoring performance metrics and adjusting as needed.
Evaluate trained models using validation datasets and metrics, such as accuracy, precision, and recall.
Refine and tune models based on evaluation results, iterating on architecture, hyperparameters, and training data.
Deploy trained models to production environments, integrating with existing infrastructure and applications.
Monitor model performance in production, collecting metrics and feedback to inform future model updates and improvements.
Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to integrate AI models with broader data pipelines and workflows.
Document model development, training, and deployment processes, including data sources, hyperparameters, and performance metrics.
Collect and integrate data from various sources, including databases, APIs, and file systems.
Clean and preprocess data, handling missing values, outliers, and data normalization.
Transform and feature-engineer data, applying techniques such as encoding, scaling, and dimensionality reduction.
Split data into training, validation, and testing sets, ensuring representative and unbiased samples.
Explore and visualize data distributions, relationships, and patterns, using statistical and graphical methods.
Develop and apply data quality checks, ensuring data consistency, accuracy, and completeness.
Store and manage prepared data in suitable formats and repositories, such as data warehouses or data lakes.
Document data sources, processing steps, and resulting datasets, maintaining data lineage and provenance.
Collaborate with data engineers to design and implement data pipelines, integrating data preparation with broader workflows.
Continuously monitor and refine data preparation processes, adapting to changing data sources, quality, and requirements.
Containerize trained models using containerization tools, ensuring consistent and reliable deployment.
Develop and implement model serving architectures, using frameworks and libraries for scalable and efficient deployment.
Configure and manage model deployment environments, including infrastructure, networking, and security settings.
Monitor model performance and latency in production, using metrics and logging to identify areas for improvement.
Implement model updating and rollback strategies, ensuring seamless transitions between model versions.
Develop and apply model explainability and interpretability techniques, providing insights into model decisions and behavior.
Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate models with broader applications and services, ensuring seamless interactions and data exchange.
Establish and maintain model maintenance schedules, including regular updates, retraining, and performance evaluations.
Document model deployment, maintenance, and performance, maintaining records of model versions, configurations, and metrics.
Continuously evaluate and improve model deployment and maintenance processes, adapting to changing requirements, technologies, and best practices.
Participate in project planning and requirements gathering, ensuring clear understanding of project goals and objectives.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, engineers, and product managers, to ensure aligned goals and effective communication.
Develop and maintain technical documentation, including model descriptions, data sources, and deployment details.
Present technical results and insights to non-technical stakeholders, using clear and concise language and visualizations.
Provide technical guidance and support to junior team members, mentoring and knowledge-sharing to promote skill growth and development.
Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards, best practices, and security guidelines.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends, research, and technologies, applying knowledge to improve project outcomes and contribute to the development of best practices.
Contribute to the development of internal tools, frameworks, and libraries, promoting efficiency, scalability, and maintainability.
Collaborate with external partners and vendors, ensuring effective communication and integration of third-party technologies and services.
Participate in retrospectives and post-mortem analyses, identifying areas for improvement and implementing changes to enhance team performance and project outcomes.
